msg: There are pairs of gnomes. The best choices without question are PURPLE, BLUE, BROWN, ORANGE. If you choose these consistently you will get a good score. To achieve the highest possible score you must follow an additional strategy. When you notice that the payout drops, change to the other gnome (opposite colour) until the payout drops again, around 3-5 rounds. Then go back to the original best choice colours as above.In short keep these in memory and choose them:Purple,Blue,Orange,Brown,When you notice that the gnomes have 'swapped' then change choices until you notice it swap back, only usually a few rounds.There is an element of randomness which you should not let discourage you from this strategy.If you must experiment by choosing a colour that i have no reccomended, only do this on the 1x so that you don't miss out on too many points.Your score directly influences my bonus and i have written this detailed message so that we can both benefit. Good luck.
